digest.component_or_area: DC/Jira Data Center outbound text sanitization and reconciliation
propositions: DC lacks convergence test suites for oversized comments and descriptions, exposing risk of infinite re-emission if truncated values do not round-trip

DC comment and description sanitizers are currently bound to a shared WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT constant (32767) without documented provenance, making it appear as an assumption rather than a design decision grounded in Jira's jira.text.field.character.limit property

Injecting DC backend explicitly into convergence tests is required because the OR-guarded fallback in compute_outbound_mutations and _resolve_sanitizer will silently resolve to Cloud if any mapper/sanitizer parameter is omitted, causing tests to converge against wrong truncation logic

Value-based assertions alone cannot prove DC's sanitizer ran in comment convergence tests because DC and Cloud both truncate at the same limit (32767) with identical suffix markers, requiring identity/recording checks instead
The ceiling itself (32767 for stock Jira >= 7.0) is established from primary sources (Jira jpm.xml and JRASERVER-28519) and should be cited at the binding rather than re-measured or marked unverified
